title: Minepolitica
description: A Client-Sided Modpack for the Minepolitica server
body:
# Minepolitica — A Living World of Nations, Trade, and Story

Minepolitica is a player-driven Minecraft simulation centered on worldbuilding, cooperation, and emergent storytelling. The server is home to a diverse collection of nations, each shaped by its own culture, values, and ambitions. Every settlement, border, and alliance exists because players built it, negotiated it, or fought for it.

Rather than focusing on a single playstyle, Minepolitica offers a living society where players take on meaningful roles. Some rise as rulers, ministers, or diplomats, guiding the direction of their nations. Others become merchants, industrialists, builders, explorers, or specialists whose work forms the backbone of the world’s economy and infrastructure. Politics exist, but they are only one part of a broader social and cultural simulation.

Trade routes emerge, cities grow, alliances form and fracture, and history is written collectively over time. Whether your interest lies in governance, economics, architecture, or simply carving out a place in a larger world, Minepolitica is designed to support long-term, immersive play.
 
## About This Modpack

This is a **Client-side Modpack** created to enhance the Minepolitica experience. It focuses on quality-of-life improvements, performance, and immersion while remaining fully compatible with the server. No gameplay-altering advantages are included.

## Whitelisting & Community Access

Minepolitica is a **whitelisted server** to ensure a committed and respectful player base.
To apply for access, you must join the official [Discord server](https://discord.gg/WABXct9cAb), where validation and onboarding are handled. This allows the community to maintain consistent standards and ensures that new players understand the server’s expectations and structure.

## What to Expect

- Player-run nations with distinct identities

- A living economy driven by trade and specialization

- Long-term worldbuilding and historical continuity

- Structured role-play without rigid restrictions

- A curated, community-focused environment

Minepolitica is not about winning — it is about participating in a shared world and leaving a lasting mark on it.
